enable_language(C)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
set(INSTALL_DOCS OFF)
set(INSTALL_CMAKE_PACKAGE_MODULE OFF)
set(INSTALL_PKG_CONFIG_MODULE OFF)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0048 NEW)
add_subdirectory(ogg EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(OGG_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ogg/include")
set(OGG_LIBRARY Ogg::ogg)
add_subdirectory(vorbis EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set_target_properties(ogg vorbis vorbisenc PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
foreach(target ogg vorbis vorbisenc)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/O2> $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/Ob2> $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/Zo>)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-O2>)
    endif()
endforeach()
